title: Bar chart
description: Use to compare a handful of categories: horizontal bars grow in one after another with value labels. Transparent overlay with light text by default (theme 'dark'): put it on a dark backdrop, or pass theme="light" for light backdrops.
props: {data: {label: string; value: number}[]; title?: string; color?: string /*'#38bdf8'*/; valueFormat?: string /*',.0f'*/; startFrame?: number /*5*/; staggerFrames?: number /*6*/; fontFamily?: string; textColor?: string; theme?: 'dark'|'light' /*'dark'*/}
example:
import {ChartBars} from './blocks/chart-bars/ChartBars.tsx';
<ChartBars title="Users by region" data={[{label: "Europe", value: 420}, {label: "Asia", value: 610}]} />
